Both let me open any saved bookmark, change the title, tag, and note, and the card updated right there — no re-pasting the address, which is exactly what I was missing. And I like that the web address and the saved copy stay untouched; I'm only tidying my own details, not disturbing the underlying link or the preserved page.

Between the two ways in, I'll go with Version A — the plain "Edit" button sitting on the card. With Version B's little "…" menu I'd have to click it first just to discover editing is in there; the labeled button tells me straight away that this is how I fix something up. So Version A is my pick, as long as opening the editor that way still leaves the address and the saved copy alone.

Ready for the delete flow whenever you are.
